description: This Java class 'VerifyPickSession' manages the process of verifying and processing pick sessions in a shipment system, including creating verification rows, handling inventory reservations, creating shipments, and updating product info.

classes.name: VerifyPickSession
classes.description: Manages verification of pick items, creation of shipment, and inventory updates in a shipment process.

methods.name: createRow
methods.description: Creates a verification row for a specific order item, handling inventory reservations and quantity checks.

methods.name: findOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Finds the order item sequence ID based on product, order, and quantity.

methods.name: checkRowForAdd
methods.description: Checks if a reservation can hold the requested quantity and updates or creates verification rows accordingly.

methods.name: createVerifyPickRow
methods.description: Creates a new VerifyPickSessionRow based on check results.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the pick session, verifies quantities, creates shipment, issues items, and updates products.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues verified items to the shipment.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record based on a pick session line.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates product information such as origin geo ID.
